Four Accused in Tiger Shroff Shooting Case Remanded to Custody

Four individuals accused in the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff's car have been remanded to police custody. Gangster Anil Pandit, associated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, has been identified as the mastermind and declared a wanted accused in the case. Reports suggest suspects tested a gun near Mumbai prior to the attack. The incident has revived memories of the 1990s when gangsters reportedly influenced the Bollywood industry.
